items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1961-06-28
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...there's a hall of Richard M. Jones, they used to call him Miney Jones... Did you ever hear of that? [INTERVIEWEE] Tintop. Tintop. That was on, uh.

ctx.x: Yeah, uh, between 6th Street. Oh, I see, yeah. That's far up, yeah. Oh, I see, yeah. It was, yeah.

Oh, how do I think of it? Uh, there's a hall of Richard M. Jones, they used to call him Miney Jones, the piano player. Uh, oh yeah, yeah. He told me once that, uh, Bolden and some of the old time bands played at a place called Tintight Hall. Did you ever hear of that? Tintight.
Tintop. Tintop. That was on, uh.
